form_note: Closest standard form category: logo-reveal. This is intentionally a custom seven-slot UI/logo product sting governed by the bs-hyperframes-velocity-sting structure, not an ordinary single-shot logo reveal.
style: Precise, fast, reassuring, product-led motion. Seven clean RegisterBox surfaces behave as one continuous camera move through strict velocity-matched cuts, crisp mobile UI geometry, restrained depth, and one mirrored exponential ease family. No idle float, pulse, bounce, narration, or explanatory detours.

resolved_assets.provenance: Copied from the user-owned RegisterBox app repository; no external search or capture.
resolved_assets.usage: Render as a rounded app tile because the 1024x1024 raster has a full-frame white background. Use clipping windows over the same source for the perceptual mark/wordmark split; do not attempt transparency removal or vectorization.

catalog_searches.query: velocity-matched continuous-camera UI sting with matched directional cuts
catalog_searches.decision: No single registry block or component covers the required seven-slot, mixed-axis, exact-seam structure. Use cut-the-curve and whip-pan-cut only as motion references for same-axis velocity continuity; do not use their stock easing because the specialized skill requires the custom EO/EI functions.

catalog_searches.query: oversized cursor click on a primary action
catalog_searches.decision: oversized-cursor is the closest behavior reference for slot F: a 3.5x pointer lands tip-first, clicks, settles below the control so the result remains visible, then exits. Reproduce that behavior inside the monolithic timeline rather than adding a sub-composition.

logo-outro and logo-sting are generic references, but neither fits the supplied raster tile, the required counter-moving two-part lockup, or the incoming z-negative seam. Use the skill's counter-bounce and pull-back landing instead; omit glow bloom, impact flash, URL pill, and piece-by-piece vector assembly.

customize.reuse_decision: No registry result fits the whole structure. Build one hand-authored GSAP timeline in the standalone index.html, using registry results only as behavior references and using no sub-compositions.
customize.file_contract: One standalone HTML composition with embedded CSS/SVG/GSAP choreography; external files are limited to the frozen local logo asset plus project metadata and the separate seam ledger.

registry_rule_references.name: cut-the-curve
registry_rule_references.apply: Same-axis, same-direction hard-cut continuity at peak velocity across all six seams; replace its power4 family with the exact custom EO/EI mirror pair.

registry_rule_references.name: whip-pan-cut
registry_rule_references.apply: Use its capped, direction-derived motion-blur principle for x/y seams only; blur must be driven by the same EO/EI progress and clear at rest.

registry_rule_references.name: oversized-cursor
registry_rule_references.apply: Slot F pointer actor at 3.5x normal size: tip-first EO arrival, click compression/ring, settle below the button to preserve menu visibility, then EI exit.

registry_rule_references.name: logo-sting
registry_rule_references.apply: Reference only the readable lockup hold; do not use its slam, impact ring, or white flash. The specialized counter-bounce and seam motion take precedence.

timeline.continuous_properties: Tween with EO for arrival and EI for departure, passed as functions rather than stock ease names.
timeline.discrete_choreography: Stamp typing, readiness values, navigation highlight decisions, cursor click states, and menu rows frame by frame with tl.set(...).
timeline.determinism: Repeat every animated property in both from/to states, use no Math.random, and use no infinite repeat.

layout.safe_area: Keep critical text and controls inside a 96px inset; off-canvas travel is deliberate and must be marked with the appropriate HyperFrames layout allowances.
layout.surface_language: Mobile-first rounded cards, large touch targets, navy hierarchy, blue primary actions, hairline borders, and generous whitespace.

customize.logo_treatment: Keep the white-backed raster as a rounded app tile. Measure the visible artwork bounds from a rendered frame before final positioning. Split mark and wordmark perceptually with clipping windows over duplicate instances, not by editing the asset.
customize.slot_f_cursor: The oversized pointer enters already moving within slot F, lands its tip on Start registration, compresses for the click, triggers the menu, settles below/right so all three menu rows remain visible, then leaves while the action group begins the z-negative exit.
customize.endcard: Pull back into the raster tile plus RegisterBox wordmark and one closing line. Use the required two-part damped counter-bounce and finish on a clean readable hold; no URL, bloom, flash, particle assembly, or additional slogan.
customize.audio: No audio element and no audio track in the MP4.

shot_brief: The viewer experiences RegisterBox as one uninterrupted, confident move: its mark and wordmark counter-bounce into life, drive downward into a sign-in card, sweep left into a closer email-entry moment, rise into a 100% GST-readiness count, travel right across the real app navigation, push through into the primary registration action and its next-step menu, then pull back into a crisp brand endcard. The single dominant motion idea is matched velocity at every cut; outgoing and incoming elements share axis, direction, and comparable speed so none of the seven slots ever feels like a separate slide.

rules: Pass the custom ease functions themselves; do not substitute stock named eases.
Every cut is velocity-matched: neither side may be settled at the seam.
Tween continuous curves; stamp typing, number steps, row selection, and menu decisions frame by frame.
Derive motion blur from the same motion ease and remove it at rest.
Use no random, infinite repeat, idle float, breathing, pulse, or generic bounce motion.

seven_slots.name: brand-lockup
seven_slots.visual: Split the supplied app-icon artwork into the graphic mark and the RegisterBox wordmark as two perceptual parts. Keep the raster source unaltered; use clipping/masking for the split and measure its real visible bounds before placement.
seven_slots.motion: The mark and wordmark arrive with equal-and-opposite damped counter-bounce, then remain in downward flight into the A-to-B seam. The counter-bounce is the only spring-like motion in the film and must use the specified damped formula, not a stock elastic ease.

seven_slots.name: entry-surface
seven_slots.visual: A clean mobile sign-in card on the pale ground, using RegisterBox blue for the primary action and navy ink for hierarchy.
seven_slots.motion: Enter already moving downward from the matched seam, decelerate just enough to read, then accelerate left before the B-to-C cut.

seven_slots.name: entry-surface-close
seven_slots.visual: The same sign-in surface as B, closer on the business-email field; do not introduce a different screen.
seven_slots.motion: Enter already moving left. Stamp an intentionally uneven typing rhythm into the email field, then carry the focused field upward through the C-to-D cut.

seven_slots.name: hero-number
seven_slots.visual: One oversized readiness number with a compact supporting label and restrained success accent; no chart and no competing metrics.
seven_slots.motion: Enter already moving upward. Stamp irregular, accelerating readiness values that resolve at 100%, hold legibility briefly, then move right into the D-to-E seam.

seven_slots.name: primary-navigation
seven_slots.visual: The real five-row RegisterBox primary navigation. A blue selection band chooses Compliance while clipped navy duplicate labels preserve contrast over the highlight.
seven_slots.motion: Rows enter already moving right with deliberately uneven spacing. Stamp the highlight path across the real rows, select Compliance, then keep the selected row growing toward camera for the E-to-F push-through.
measure_after_first_render: Each row's off-screen start from its settled rendered width.
The Compliance highlight's resting width from the pre-highlight frame, using text width plus fixed padding.

seven_slots.name: primary-action
seven_slots.copy_budget_note: The repository brief explicitly requires the product label 'Start registration'. At 18 characters including the space, it is a controlled exception to the generic 16-character slot-F guideline; preserve the product language and fit it with width/padding, not condensed or undersized type.
seven_slots.visual: A prominent RegisterBox-blue primary button and a compact three-step next-action menu that opens from the button corner, then recenters as a group.
seven_slots.motion: Enter already growing from the push-through. Use three distinct beats: arrive at the control, activate it with a decisive cursor/contact response, then reveal the next-step menu with stamped row decisions. The whole result begins shrinking before the F-to-G cut. If button dimensions change, update the button box, menu origin, and recentering nudge together.

seven_slots.name: endcard
seven_slots.visual: The supplied mark and RegisterBox wordmark land as the hero lockup on the pale brand ground, with one closing line only.
seven_slots.motion: Enter already shrinking from the pull-back, settle through the shared arrival ease, and give the two lockup parts a subtle two-frame-staggered counter-bounce before the final readable hold.

rights.logo: User-supplied local RegisterBox asset from the user's repository; no external capture.
rights.ui: RegisterBox product language and neutral original HTML/CSS/SVG surfaces only; no third-party UI or iconography.
rights.type: Generic system-ui stack; no proprietary font file is embedded or redistributed.

verification_notes: Measure the supplied logo's visible content bounds before final placement because the PNG contains surrounding white space.
After the first render, paste back all text-dependent navigation measurements from settled frames.
Verify every seam using frames immediately before and after each cut: both sides must move on the planned axis and sign.
The final deliverable is silent: do not create or include an audio track.
